definitions.gloss: wild mountain vegetables, edible wild plants
definitions.explanation: Edible plants that grow wild in the mountains and fields. Gathering and eating them is a traditional seasonal activity in Japan, especially in spring.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}に{山菜|さんさい}を{採|と}る。
examples.english: To gather wild vegetables in spring.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷらにした{山菜|さんさい}はとても{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Wild mountain vegetables made into tempura are very delicious.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{毎年|まいとし}{春|はる}になると{山|やま}に{入|はい}って{山菜|さんさい}を{採|と}り、{近所|きんじょ}の{人|ひと}にも{分|わ}けてくれる。
examples.english: Every spring, my grandmother goes into the mountains to gather wild vegetables and shares them with the neighbors.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
{山|さん} (mountain) + {菜|さい} (vegetable, greens).

USAGE:
{山菜|さんさい} refers to a broad category of wild edible plants harvested from mountains and forests. Gathering them ({山菜|さんさい}{採|と}り) is a popular seasonal activity in spring. Common varieties include {蕨|わらび} (bracken fern), {蕗|ふき} (butterbur), and たらの{芽|め} (aralia sprouts). Many require preparation such as removing bitterness ({灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き) before eating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山菜|さんさい}{採|と}り: gathering wild vegetables
- {山菜|さんさい}の{天|てん}ぷら: tempura of wild vegetables
- {山菜|さんさい}そば: soba noodles with wild vegetables
- {山菜|さんさい}{料理|りょうり}: wild vegetable cuisine
